description: Wonderland Ephemeral Catalog - Single source of truth for transient self-terminating components. All entries are auditable, intent-driven, and produce bitemporal artifacts only.

entries.intent: Enforce Python execution guardrails (isolate, automate, validate, recover) for all child ephemeral Python components without global package pollution.
